title: app.manifest.json (schemaVersion 1)
description: Canonical per-app manifest for the standalone AGS app program (AD-26/AD-30). Every app repo ships app.manifest.json at its root and deploys it with the app. Identity fields are one lowercase path segment; mode restart is invalid when holdsUnsavedState is true.

mode.description: live apps answer palette-refresh in place; restart apps are restarted by the serialized restart lane. A failed live refresh never becomes a restart (AD-30).

holdsUnsavedState.description: true when a restart could discard user work. Restart is invalid for any such app (AD-26/AD-30).

pathSegment.description: Exactly one lowercase path segment: no slash, no dot path, no uppercase, no leading/trailing hyphen.
